blocks.x: Asset Tokenization & Digital Assets as delivered by Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, the platforms involved and the outcomes we commit to at each gate.

Tokenization turns assets into programmable instruments — private credit, funds, trade assets, receivables, real assets — but the hard problems are legal and operational, not cryptographic. We deliver tokenization programs with securities-law discipline: instrument structuring with counsel, permissioned transfer controls (whitelists, locks, transfer restrictions), investor onboarding with KYC/AML gating, qualified custody arrangements, and lifecycle automation — coupons, redemptions, corporate actions — executed by smart contracts with human override paths.

The stack is institution-grade: compliant issuance platforms, transfer-agent integration, primary and secondary venues where regulation permits, and reporting pipelines that produce regulator-readable records. We build pilots that produce evidence for supervisory dialogue — the path tier-one institutions actually follow to production.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
